scope: M03 independent events only (63); no other mechanism; no opportunity re-discovery

shock_definition.reused_from: R1/R2 detector threshold (not a new scan)
shock_definition.shock_source_rule: source with the largest abs(z); MULTI_SOURCE if >=2 sources >= 2
shock_definition.shock_direction_rule: sign of that source 60m move, recorded independently of XAU

response_windows.note: four pre-registered windows; later addition of 10/15/30/60m is forbidden

primary_expression.definition: after a cross-market shock, take the XAU position against the shock sign and hold 6 hours with no entry delay

direction_rule.aligned: same direction as the shock sign

cost_model.slippage: historical per-event slippage unavailable - cost stress only, never faked

permutation.method: event times redrawn uniformly inside the M03 span

negative_control.pass_if: control mean response <= observed mean response

multiple_testing.family: 4 source classes (DXY/VIX/UST10Y_PROXY/MULTI_SOURCE) x 2 directions = 8 tests at R2

episode_grouping.rule: consecutive M03 events within 24h share a macro_episode_id

execution.rule: an event is feasible if the R1 response magnitude survives 1x cost and the R0 response is not fully reversed; EXECUTION_UNREALISTIC if the feasible fraction < 0.5

status_rule.PROMISING: primary expression holds AND net_edge_1x > 0 AND WF consistent (3/3) AND permutation p <= 0.05 with FDR control AND effective_n >= 8 AND execution feasible AND events_per_week >= 1.0
status_rule.NOT_PROMISING: gross edge weak OR net_edge_1x <= 0 OR WF inconsistent OR execution unrealistic
status_rule.INSUFFICIENT: effective_n < 8 OR data quality insufficient OR timestamp precision insufficient OR source semantics cannot support the conclusion
status_rule.no_evasion: the output must be exactly one of the three; UNCERTAIN is not allowed here
